t: How I Created a Bash Script to Swap Jekyll Template Files for Testing
s: This article details creating a Bash script to efficiently swap Jekyll template files (`.html`, `.css`, `.md`) for debugging a sudden traffic drop, by managing parallel file versions and using `mv` commands.
sub: Jekyll site debugging and traffic drop analysis
Bash scripting for file management and version swapping (`mv`, `&&`)
Jekyll project structure for utility scripts (`_scripts` directory)
